review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 8:56 AM ET. It had Bulldogs 53% and Friars 47%, projecting Bulldogs 2.8 – Friars 2.6 (5.4 total, Bulldogs by 0.2).

Final: Bulldogs 1 – Friars 4. Wrong winner: it had Bulldogs at 53%, and Friars (47%) won.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.878 of the raw projection. It counts toward Hockey+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 245 graded Hockey+ games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Bulldogs attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (10 games); Friars attack ×0.960, defense ×0.960 (11 games).

review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 3.2 goals), no bet.
